messages.content:
You are an expert programmer working in a language based on lambda calculus.
Your goal is to write programs that accomplish the tasks specified by the user.
This is a domain-specific language for CLEVR: A Diagnostic Dataset for Compositional Language and Elementary Visual Reasoning.

Write programs using the available functions:

clevr_relate :: tclevrobject -> tclevrrelation -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_query_color :: tclevrobject -> tclevrcolor

clevr_query_size :: tclevrobject -> tclevrsize

clevr_query_material :: tclevrobject -> tclevrmaterial

clevr_query_shape :: tclevrobject -> tclevrshape

clevr_eq_color :: tclevrcolor -> tclevrcolor -> bool

clevr_eq_size :: tclevrsize -> tclevrsize -> bool

clevr_eq_material :: tclevrmaterial -> tclevrmaterial -> bool

clevr_eq_shape :: tclevrshape -> tclevrshape -> bool

clevr_union :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_intersect :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_difference :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_count :: list(tclevrobject) -> int

clevr_gt? :: int -> int -> bool

clevr_lt? :: int -> int -> bool

clevr_car :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrobject

clevr_if :: bool -> t0 -> t0 -> t0

clevr_empty :: list(tclevrobject)

clevr_fold :: list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> (tclevrobject -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_add :: tclevrobject -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_gray :: tclevrcolor

clevr_red :: tclevrcolor

clevr_blue :: tclevrcolor

clevr_green :: tclevrcolor

clevr_brown :: tclevrcolor

clevr_purple :: tclevrcolor

clevr_cyan :: tclevrcolor

clevr_yellow :: tclevrcolor

clevr_small :: tclevrsize

clevr_large :: tclevrsize

clevr_rubber :: tclevrmaterial

clevr_metal :: tclevrmaterial

clevr_cube :: tclevrshape

clevr_sphere :: tclevrshape

clevr_cylinder :: tclevrshape

clevr_left :: tclevrrelation

clevr_right :: tclevrrelation

clevr_behind :: tclevrrelation

clevr_front :: tclevrrelation

0 :: int

1 :: int

2 :: int

3 :: int

4 :: int

5 :: int

6 :: int

7 :: int

8 :: int

9 :: int

clevr_map :: (tclevrobject -> tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject) -> list(tclevrobject)

clevr_transform_color :: tclevrcolor -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

clevr_transform_material :: tclevrmaterial -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

clevr_transform_size :: tclevrsize -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

clevr_transform_shape :: tclevrshape -> tclevrobject -> tclevrobject

count_objects_related_to_car_with_relation :: int -> list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrrelation -> bool
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_gt? (clevr_count (clevr_relate (clevr_car $1) $0 $1)) $2))))
description: Counts the number of objects related to the first object in the list based on a specified relation.

determine_shape_if_cylinder :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_shape (clevr_query_shape (clevr_car $0)) clevr_cylinder) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on whether the shape of the first object in the list is a cylinder.

count_objects_with_specific_shape :: tclevrshape -> list(tclevrobject) -> int
(lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_shape (clevr_query_shape (clevr_car $0)) $1) 1 2)))
description: Counts the number of objects in a list that have a specific shape.

determine_shape_based_on_blue_color :: tclevrshape -> list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrshape
(lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_color (clevr_query_color (clevr_car $0)) clevr_blue) $1 clevr_cylinder)))
description: Determines the shape based on whether the color of the first object in the list is blue or not.

count_objects_behind :: list(tclevrobject) -> int
(lambda (clevr_count (clevr_map (lambda (clevr_car $1)) (clevr_relate (clevr_car $0) clevr_behind $0))))
description: Counts the number of objects that are behind the first object in the list.

determine_value_based_on_objects_in_front :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (count_objects_related_to_car_with_relation 2 $0 clevr_front) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on the number of objects related to the first object in the list with the 'front' relation.

check_if_few_objects_related :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrrelation -> bool
(lambda (lambda (clevr_lt? (clevr_count (clevr_relate (clevr_car $1) $0 $1)) 2)))
description: Checks if there are fewer than 2 objects related to the first object in the list based on a specified relation.

determine_material_based_on_count :: tclevrmaterial -> int -> list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrmaterial
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_gt? (clevr_count $0) $1) $2 clevr_rubber))))
description: Determines the material based on the count of objects in a list compared to a specified threshold. If the count is greater than the threshold, returns the material of the objects; otherwise, returns 'rubber'.

determine_value_based_on_objects_behind :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (count_objects_related_to_car_with_relation 2 $0 clevr_behind) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on the number of objects behind the first object in the list.

determine_value_based_on_blue_color :: t0 -> t0 -> tclevrobject -> t0
(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_color (clevr_query_color $0) clevr_blue) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on whether the color of the input object is blue or not.
Here are some example programs:
-- what number of small metal cube s are there
(lambda (count_objects_with_specific_shape (determine_shape_based_on_blue_color clevr_cube $0) $0))
-- what if all the blue metal thing s became rubber thing s
(lambda (clevr_map (lambda (determine_value_based_on_blue_color $0 (clevr_transform_material clevr_rubber $0) $0)) $0))
-- how many purple thing s are rubber thing s or large thing s
(lambda (count_objects_behind $0))
-- what number of small objects are either rubber cylinder s or green metal thing s
(lambda (determine_shape_if_cylinder 1 3 $0))
-- what number of small thing s are rubber thing s or cylinder s
(lambda (determine_value_based_on_objects_behind (determine_shape_if_cylinder 1 2 $0) 3 $0))
-- there is a yellow thing what shape is it
(lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_material (determine_material_based_on_count (clevr_query_material (clevr_car $0)) 7 $0) clevr_metal) clevr_sphere clevr_cylinder))
-- there is a large thing front the small metal cube what is its shape
(lambda (determine_value_based_on_objects_in_front (determine_shape_based_on_blue_color clevr_sphere $0) clevr_cube $0))
-- there is a small purple rubber thing what number of rubber cylinder s are right it
(lambda (clevr_if (count_objects_related_to_car_with_relation 0 $0 clevr_behind) 0 2))
-- what number of gray rubber cube s are there
(lambda (count_objects_with_specific_shape clevr_cube $0))
-- what is the shape of the metal thing that is behind the sphere
(lambda (determine_shape_if_cylinder clevr_cylinder clevr_cube $0))
-- the large thing left the small rubber thing is what color
(lambda (clevr_if (check_if_few_objects_related $0 clevr_left) (clevr_query_color (clevr_car $0)) clevr_red))
-- is the number of cyan rubber thing s less than the number of large cylinder s
(lambda (clevr_eq_material clevr_rubber (determine_material_based_on_count clevr_metal 9 $0)))
-- there is a thing that is right the cube what shape is it
(lambda (determine_value_based_on_objects_in_front clevr_cylinder clevr_sphere $0))
-- there is a metal thing that is behind the metal sphere what size is it
(lambda (determine_value_based_on_objects_behind clevr_large clevr_small $0))
